transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this production rollout plan sorted out. We've got the approved container-image security patch ready to go, and it's already passed staging validation. I need to run through the round-robin check with release engineering, infrastructure, customer operations, and compliance before I can sign off on the plan. We also have two change windows available: Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC or Tuesday 01:00-03:00 UTC. And the change record needs a rollback checkpoint before each restart wave. Let's start hearing from each team -- release engineering first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While preparing the patched image, I confirmed that 17 stateful services cannot be restarted in place -- they must be deployed in three restart waves of exactly 6, 6, and 5 services. I have not yet updated the change ticket with this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share an important infrastructure constraint: during this morning's capacity test, I measured the production control plane and confirmed that no more than 2 clusters can be patched concurrently without breaching its saturation limit. I recorded this in my infrastructure notebook but hadn't posted it to the change channel yet. This directly affects how we sequence the restart waves Mina just described.
